sensor: Thermal: uncooled VOx, 160x120, 17 um pixel pitch, NETD < 40 mK; optical: 1/2.7in CMOS
features: Thermal and optical bi-spectrum network bullet camera with deep-learning perimeter protection and fire prevention
Thermal: uncooled VOx 160x120 detector, 17 um pixel pitch, NETD < 40 mK, 9.7 mm F1.1 lens, 15.96 x 12 field of view
Optical channel: 4 MP (2688x1520), 1/2.7in CMOS, 8 mm F1.6 lens, 39.42 x 22.14 field of view, 120 dB WDR
IR supplement up to 40 m plus white-light supplement up to 40 m on the optical channel (0.0089 lux; 0 lux with IR)
Built-in white-light strobe (visual alarm) and audio warning (2 preset voice alerts)
Temperature measurement -20 to 150 C, accuracy +/-8 C
ONVIF Profile S/G/T, audio in/out, RS-485, analog BNC output

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Optical (Channel 1) and thermal (Channel 2) exposed as separate channels.

release_notes: Thermal and optical bi-spectrum network bullet camera pairing a 160x120 uncooled VOx detector (17 um, NETD < 40 mK, 9.7 mm lens) with a 4 MP optical channel, deep-learning perimeter protection, temperature-exception fire prevention, 40 m IR and white light, plus a white-light strobe and audio warning. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet.
